description: This file declares the GpxParser class, which provides static methods to parse GPX files or strings and extract GPS fixes into a provided array.

classes.name: GpxParser
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to parse GPX files and strings to extract GPS fixes.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses a specified .gpx file at |filePath| and extracts GPS fixes into |*fixes|. Returns true on success, false on failure, with the error message set in |*error|.

methods.name: parseString
methods.description: Parses a string containing GPX data, extracting GPS fixes into |*fixes|. Returns true on success, false on failure, with the error message set in |*error|.
